description: Source code for managing MIME type hierarchy, including data structures and functions for reading MIME parent relationships from a file.

classes.name: XdgMimeParents
classes.description: Data structure representing a MIME type and its parent MIME types.

classes.name: XdgParentList
classes.description: Data structure representing a list of MIME types and their parent relationships.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_parent_list_new
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new XdgParentList.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_parent_list_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an XdgParentList.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_parent_read_from_file
methods.description: Reads MIME parent relationships from a specified file and populates the list.
